main.name: Sam Ayoub
main.description: Software Architect & Engineering Director / Software Migration & Integration Consultant / FinTech, AI & SaaS
main.bio: Visionary software architect and engineering director with over 15 years of experience designing, scaling, and mentoring cross-functional teams across FinTech, AI, and SaaS industries. Expert in software migration and integration consulting, building high-performance API and cloud architectures on AWS, GCP, and Azure, with deep expertise in AI/ML systems, LLM integration, autonomous AI agents, and NVIDIA GPU-accelerated computing. Proven ability to lead large-scale digital transformations, architect intelligent systems with RAG pipelines and vector databases, and bridge business strategy with cutting-edge technology execution. Passionate about driving engineering excellence, fostering innovation, and delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent user-centric systems.
main.contactmessage: Do not hesitate to contact me anytime
